Both policies (pretrained + finetuned) fail in white-image envs. This is CONSISTENT WITH multiple hypotheses: (a) white images ARE the bottleneck, (b) images are irrelevant and action/state mismatch is the bottleneck, OR (c) both contribute. model_loading_fixes.critical_fix: RuntimeError expected Float but found BFloat16 in SigLIP encoder layer_norm
model_loading_fixes.root_cause: Checkpoint has mixed dtypes: patch_embedding=float32, encoder layer_norm=bfloat16. to_bfloat16_for_selected_params promoted whole model to bfloat16, but SiglipVisionEmbeddings converts input to float32 (matching float32 patch_embedding), causing layer_norm bfloat16 weights vs float32 input mismatch
model_loading_fixes.fix: Changed to_bfloat16_for_selected_params to convert to float32 (not bfloat16). Also fixed: embed_language_tokens (GemmaForCausalLM uses .language_model.model.embed_tokens), forward (call .language_model.model.forward not .language_model.forward), all .language_model.layers[] -> .language_model.model.layers[], comprehensive key remapping for checkpoint architecture mismatch (165 missing + 164 unexpected keys fixed)

actions.target: Verify if action that achieves attach in source sim achieves attach in DrawerRobotEnv
actions.description: RCA1/2/3/4 (drawer color) all eliminated. Root cause is simulator physics mismatch. E023: teacher demos ARE successful in source sim. E024: action normalization is correct.
